newsitem.title: INDIA: Japan's Iwatani, IOC in talks.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Iwatani, IOC in talks.

text.p: Japanese liquefied petroleum gas distributor Iwatani International Corp is in talks with Indian Oil Corp Ltd (IOC) to build an LPG import terminal in India, a senior Iwatani official said on Monday.
Hajime Mitamura, assistant manager at Iwatani's international operations department, said the project would entail investment of $5 million to $10 million.
"We'd like to export LPG to India because India imports almost half of its petroleum products," Mitamura told Reuters at the 12th Indian Engineering Trade Fair in New Delhi.
"We'd like to cooperate with an Indian company in this, and we are already in contact with IOC."
He said the two firms were planning to establish a joint venture company with equal equity stakes.
Iwatani currently imports LPG from the Middle East and distributes it in Japan and China, Mitamura said.
The firm also planned to import granite for Japan's construction industry and quartz for glass-making from India, he said.
